blurb: Guests can take guided boat tours to explore the Cedar Keys National Wildlife Refuge, watch wildlife like dolphins and manatees, and learn about local history. Offerings include pet-friendly coastal tours, sunset cruises, fishing and scalloping charters, and shuttle services to nearby islands. Tours vary in duration and schedule depending on the season and weather.
